items.title: IDCTE Founded
items.description: Registered in Copenhagen, Denmark by a group of new-generation Eelam Tamil youth from Nordic and other European countries.

items.title: Defending Elected Voices
items.description: Condemned state-linked attacks on Tamil parliamentarians, including an assassination attempt on an MP and an attack on a commemoration procession, calling on the international community to respond.

items.title: Geneva & Brussels Advocacy
items.description: Engaged the UN Human Rights Council and OHCHR in Geneva, and MEPs in Brussels and Strasbourg, pressing for an international inquiry into the genocide and withdrawal of Sri Lanka's GSP+ trade privileges.

items.title: Remembrance & Accountability
items.description: Marks Black July and Tamil Genocide Remembrance Day each year, renewing the call for justice, accountability, and self-determination for Eelam Tamils.
